data.name: Air Defence Simulator VR
data.detailed_description:
Step into the role of an air defence gunner and defend civilians, military bases, and critical infrastructure against waves of modern aerial threats. Inspired by today's evolving battlefield, Air Defence Simulator VR delivers an immersive VR experience where every successful interception can save lives.

Operate a wide range of realistic weapons, from mounted heavy machine guns and assault rifles to grenade launchers and MANPADS. Manually reload, grab equipment, and engage fast-moving targets using intuitive VR interactions.

Every mission presents new challenges. Intercept attack drones, cruise missiles, helicopters, and aircraft before they reach their targets. As the campaign progresses, enemy attacks become larger, faster, and more complex, demanding quick decisions, accuracy, and efficient use of your weapons.

Features

- Defend civilians and critical infrastructure from modern aerial threats.

- Immersive VR weapon handling with manual reloading and realistic interactions.

- Operate multiple weapon systems, including mounted machine guns, rifles, grenade launchers, and MANPADS.

- Fight against drones, missiles, helicopters, and aircraft inspired by modern warfare.

- Progressive campaign and additional content planned through future updates.

- Endless survival mode for players seeking the ultimate challenge.
